observation.event_use: group query rows only after complete output annotation

new_annotation_rule: Use complete new final videos and the same event definitions/source; retain every event and interval. Do not copy old native or weak intervals. Invisible events remain explicit missing observations.
old_video_status: historical controls retained separately; not the new capture trajectory
release_rule: Only use captures from their own complete 20-step audited trajectory and SHA-bound new final video; no failed historical replay gate substitution.
numerics: Existing FP32 RMS content definition and FP64 all-head sparse LSE unchanged; separate pre-frozen QK numerical oracle required.
